<thought>Using the given ratio 1:2:3 for three resistors R1, R2, R3 and the measured total resistance between X2 and B (16.364 Ω), the only simple topology that fits the description is a series chain of the three resistors. Solving 6k = 16.364 gives k ≈ 2.727 Ω, so R1 ≈ 2.727 Ω, R2 ≈ 5.455 Ω, R3 ≈ 8.182 Ω. The series connections are X2‑R1‑N1‑R2‑N2‑R3‑B.</thought>
